The exact source of the opening Abba report and the claimed alternate attribution remain open. The paired Taanit and Berakhot passages support Abba bar Ilai from Rav. Yoma 71a has Berekhiah’s own expositions. The listed Abba bar Kahana alternative is not silently assigned to Yoma.

The punctuation of the list leaves the direction of this first Abbahu notice uncertain. The Yalkut and the separate Heilprin headword confirm Berekhiah from Avin, while the Kohelet passage later contains the Abbahu chain.

The adjacent Rabbi Assi and Rav Assi notices are distinct. The Matnot Kehunah gloss supports the named report with Rav Assi. Berakhot 4:4:11 has a separate Rabbi Yasa in a Berekhiah list, with the exact identification of Heilprin’s bare listing still open.
Zeira’s precise relationship in this compressed list remains open. The checked Taanit chain also names Zeira, and the Peah comparison securely pairs Berekhiah with Chiyya of Kefar Techumin.
The exact Yelammedenu locus and its transmission remain open. The targeted search found no matching Berekhiah and Chiyya bar Abba chain in the Acharei Mot material.
The exact transmission directly from Chelbo remains open. The checked Kilayim witness gives a question to Chelbo and the other cited parallels place the two in lists of transmitters.
An exact joint occurrence is not confirmed. The name search led to other Eikhah material. The compressed list does not specify transmission direction.

The precise chapter 11 parallel from Rabbi Yehudah is unconfirmed. The checked chapter has Berekhiah from Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korcha and Rabbi Elazar HaModa’i and in the Chanina tradition. These are separate attributions.
The exact Yudan Berabbi chain remains open. The similarly titled Yudan passages on piercing in entry 804 do not contain Berekhiah.
The underlying early locus remains open. The later quotation in Ahavat Chesed confirms a chain in circulation. The initial index found a different Yerushalmi chain in the ancestral merit discussion.

The specific Berekhiah and Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi comparison remains open at the printed locator. The exact adjacent Berekhiah chain reaches Chanina, and does not establish another direction of transmission for a bare “and”.
No exact Yochanan bar Naggara testimony was located. The bounded phrase search for this separate transmission returned no match.

The provisional expansion to Rabbi Akiva is preserved with its exact attribution unresolved. The chapter 11 search found Berekhiah beside Dostai and Shmuel bar Nachman. It did not confirm this transmission from Rabbi Akiva.

The second Ulla occurrence and the separate Pappi report remain unbound. The dance witnesses establish the varying spellings elsewhere in the list. They do not supply the family reading or the adjacent Pappi report.
The exact Kritzpah transmission remains open. Checked bounded searches for both the printed and variant name spelling.
The precise Rav chain at this chapter remains unlocated. The digital Shekalim chapter has Berekhiah in separate contexts. The other two cited passages directly name Rav.
The exact separate report from Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai remains open. The checked joint occurrence treats Shimon as a co-transmitter, not the source.
The other Resh Lakish locus needs collation. The checked chapter 34 did not locate the chain; the Shekalim reference independently corroborates it.
The exact Shimon ben Yosini transmission remains open. A targeted name and formula search was inconclusive.

The specific Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel chain remains open at the printed location. Chapter 86 names Berekhiah in the name of Rabbi Yehudah bar Simon and in his own voice. Those readings do not settle Heilprin’s reference.

The two bare names remain as printed, with the relevant relationships open. The checked Tanchuma chain is the preceding Tanchum bar Chanilai notice. The targeted search did not yield a confirming chain for these two.
The plural sons are unnamed and their exact attachment remains uncertain. Compared the placement in the full article and the adjacent separate listings. No individual identities were inferred.
